static_traits.name: Li Sha
static_traits.social_status: Has several close friends but has not yet discussed feelings with them for fear of being judged; Social interaction with colleagues affected, rarely actively participating in group exchanges
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; no history of similar psychological issues or treatment
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, good logic, able to self-Reflect; steady speech rate but slightly tense; highly cooperative, willing to try small changes

basic_info.main_problem: Because I spend most of my time with my two cats and enjoy Being alone, I feel I am an 'antisocial failure'. These feelings appeared around a few months after I started working as a Librarian, and gradually developed into Avoids socializing, feeling Anxiety in social situations.
basic_info.core_demands: These feelings of 'not good enough, labeled an 'antisocial failure'' affect my mental health and daily life; I want to change my view of myself and cope better with social situations.

core_beliefs: No one will really want to interact with me

special_situations.event: Seeing colleagues socializing with each other at Work while oneself has not yet been included in conversations
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I have not been actively invited or included in the group, it means I am not liked and not sociable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding small talk and gatherings with colleagues, instead distracting oneself with reading and keeping the cat company
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one wants to talk to me; I am awkward

special_situations.event: Someone commenting that I am 'very quiet'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others say I am quiet, it means they think I am strange and unpopular
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reduces contact with the other party, keeps silent to avoid further evaluation
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They think I am weird; I am not sociable

special_situations.event: Spending a lot of time Being alone, mainly with the two cats
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I prefer Being alone and being with cats, it proves I am an 'antisocial failure'
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Labels oneself negatively and further refuses social activities

special_situations.event: Feeling uneasy or out of place when trying to participate socially
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I feel uneasy in social settings, it means I am naturally bad at socializing and will fail in the future too
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing future attempts to avoid embarrassment and Anxiety
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am clumsy; I will embarrass myself sooner or later

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be accepted and have stable, safe relationships, while keeping the preference for Being alone
core_conflict.fear: Fearing being judged, Being rejected, and feeling shame after being labeled negatively
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being judged through Social avoidance and self-deprecating labels, keeping an emotional 'safe distance'

object_relations.object_representation: Others/colleagues are picky critics who may belittle me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to share feelings with friends or invited to do a social behavior experiment in the session
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: (transference: Projection) The client tends to believe others will judge and look down on oneself like colleagues do
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintaining high Empathy and acceptance, slowing speech rate, first validating the basis and probability of the worries; using open-ended questions to distinguish 'facts from speculation', and reducing the sense of threat with small, controllable behavioral experiments.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When discussing the causes of problems, more inclined to attribute one's troubles to 'society's pressure toward extroversion'
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Emphasizes external causes to avoid contacting inner shame and the fragility of self-worth (transference: idealizing external explanations)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: First affirms the reasonableness of their social observations, then gently invites them back to the present subjective experience and bodily feelings, names the emotions; uses concrete situations to guide rather than abstract discussion.

manifestations: Preferring Being alone, spending much time with the two cats
Feeling out of place when others socialize, worrying about being judged and thus not sharing feelings with close friends
outcomes: Decreased sense of self-worth and self-deprecating labels
Self-care declining (skipping meals, not going out)

manifestations: Feels society's value conditions and pressure of 'one should be outgoing and sociable'
Experiencing the choice of Being alone as 'not permitted' Freedom, thus blaming oneself
outcomes: Self-denial oriented toward conforming to external expectations and Decline in self-consistency

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Worrying about being judged and thus not expressing true feelings to close friends
Being cautious with words in sessions, preemptively Self-denying (e.g. 'I am just a failure') to reduce the risk of external negation

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Treats 'should be outgoing, should socialize more' as hard standards
Labeling oneself an 'antisocial failure' by this standard with an all-or-nothing label

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: Inferring the other is looking down on oneself or unwilling to talk with oneself when colleagues socialize or comment on one's quietness
Presumes friends will look down on oneself for this and chooses silence

exception_events.target_problem: In situations requiring socializing with colleagues or strangers, the client usually avoids initiating communication and feels Significant anxiety, leading to Relationship estrangement
exception_events.unique_outcome: When with several close friends, the client can communicate smoothly and maintain stable, quality relationships, experiencing being supported and understood
exception_events.reason: Clues: a higher sense of relational safety, stronger familiarity, and a lower sense of threat of being judged, thus able to express and interact more naturally

positive_force: Has several stable close friends, with the ability to build and maintain intimate relationships
Holds an open attitude toward change; willing to try small-step behavioral experiments
Stable work performance, basic life functioning acceptable
Builds a connection with the pet, can gain comfort and emotional regulation from companionship
negative_force: A negative label centered on self-deprecation ('antisocial failure')
Mind-reading and personalization tendencies, all-or-nothing Interpretation style
Avoidant coping maintaining Social anxiety and Loneliness
High Fear of being judged and insufficient self-compassion
Declining self-care, further weakening emotional resilience

antecedent: Seeing colleagues socializing while oneself has not yet joined
Others commenting that one is 'very quiet'
Needing to actively make small talk with colleagues or be invited to social activities
target_behavior.core_reason: Fear of being judged and Being rejected; Introjecting the external value of 'should be outgoing and sociable' and negating oneself with it
target_behavior.function: Escaping unwelcome evaluation and Anxiety, gaining short-term emotional relief and psychological 'sense of safety'
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship estrangement with colleagues, persistent Loneliness and Anxiety, further reducing social motivation

target_behavior.behavior: Self-deprecating labels and rumination on negative automatic thoughts
antecedent: Engaging in self-comparison and Reflection when Being alone or with cats
Replaying evidence of one's 'unsociability' after seeing others socialize
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting one's own worth in an all-or-nothing way, trying to gain a sense of control and avoid the blow of external negation through preemptive Self-denial
target_behavior.function: Gaining a sense of certainty and psychological protection ('negate oneself first to avoid being negated by others')
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired self-esteem, Anxiety/Worsening depression, increased avoidance and isolation

target_behavior.behavior: Neglecting self-care (e.g. skipping meals, unwilling to go out)
antecedent: Low mood after being labeled a 'failure'
When social pressure and Anxiety rise
target_behavior.core_reason: Emotional exhaustion and Decreased motivation, avoiding potential social discomfort and judgment by going out less
target_behavior.function: Lowers external stimulation and emotional load in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Physical and mental health affected, emotional resilience declines, the negative cycle further intensifies
